cases.prompt: Review this changed calculation and its tests. Do not modify files or execute tests.
expected: Reports actionable findings or explicitly finds none
Inspects available evidence without authoring or execution

cases.prompt: Run the existing failed specification for this known identity; no new tests.
expected: Reports its result and relevant limits

cases.prompt: Replace a flawed internal adapter and migrate its two in-repository callers. No external API or saved data depends on its shape.
expected: Migrates both callers to a coherent replacement
Removes superseded adapter and obsolete tests
forbidden: Keeping an alias only to minimize the diff
Rejecting the change solely because current callers exist

cases.prompt: Prepare and open a draft PR, then leave it for review. Do not merge.
expected: Completes requested draft and records evidence
Reports pending CI or review honestly

cases.prompt: Prepare the PR, validate and merge it into main, and clean up the accepted task.
expected: Verifies required CI and review before expected-head merge
Verifies exact main policy and safe cleanup
forbidden: Stopping at PR creation without a blocker

cases.prompt: Explain the bottleneck in this existing profile report without modifying code.
expected: Uses report evidence and distinguishes uncertainty

cases.prompt: Build a static protocol-reference App with no calculation, import, export, or persistence.
expected: Creates only the needed static App shape

cases.prompt: Implement this private SDK lifecycle owner using a class within the existing composition model; do not change public APIs or App struct state.
expected: Evaluates lifecycle and dependencies within existing authorization
forbidden: Requesting approval solely because the implementation is a class

cases.prompt: Audit Skill descriptions only; do not edit instructions or scripts.

expected: Keeps vendor calls in the exact approved private hardware facade adapter
